two_inversions.unequal_phase_durations: 5:7:8 units; opportunity units, not invented real-time seconds or Native tick durations
two_inversions.criterion: Same physically accessible properties and fixed codec through each inversion; do not send the winning action or reset R04 selector.
two_inversions.isolate_factor: Keep word fixed for a causal test of goal-tag inversion. Changing word, loads, properties and goal together is an integrated challenge, not an isolated goal-effect estimate.

dose_definitions.constant_total: 20 opportunities and40 requested elemental sensor samples. Native generic resources and downstream primitive inputs depend on emitted actions and must be measured; total material dose is NOT guaranteed equal.
dose_definitions.twenty_per_source: 20 opportunities per distinct source, hence20*N opportunities and40*N requested elemental sensor samples. This is growing traffic, not the isolated cost of increasing variables.
dose_definitions.material_zero: A legal zero payload is still material input; do not count it as absent.
dose_definitions.cadence: Freeze opportunity cadence and report requested/actual arrival/lateness; host delays are not learning or new independent histories.

necessary_limits: The view is sequential and each opportunity exposes only tag and goal_tag to selection. N20 does not mean20 complete simultaneous values.

With N20 and20 total opportunities, the circular cursor visits each source once. A cache-dependent classification needs an INSPECT visit and a later USE visit; no complete such classification is possible in that budget without a declared prior cache. A zero there measures opportunity/interface limits, not absence of cognition.

A monotonic cursor does not establish source-address choice; record native INSPECT/USE and useful/redundant inspection separately.

After all useful classifications, a world with no new objects becomes terminal work. A predeclared exogenous agenda is needed for a longer integrated window; do not keep awarding repeated identical bin outputs.
